options.text: Hi, what brings you here?
Hey, you look like shit.
The courthouse is next door.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "I hate my job. Can you help me figure out what to do?"

beats.speaker: reader
beats.text: You turn over the top card.

options.text: Starting fresh — standing at the edge, choosing to jump.
You're an idiot for staying this long.
This card isn't about your job at all.

elaboration: The Fool's never really about the job itself — it's about you finally being willing to leap without knowing exactly where you'll land.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Hmm, I'm not sure if that applies to me."

options.text: It's about leaping before you know where you'll land.
You clearly don't want my help.
Let's just ignore the card, then.

elaboration: The Fool doesn't wait around for certainty — it trusts that clarity shows up after the jump, not before it.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Wait — the card's literally called The Fool. Are you saying I'm being an idiot?"

options.text: No — fool here means fearless beginner, not stupid.
Kind of, yeah.
Honestly, the name doesn't mean much.

elaboration: Every deck names it that on purpose — the Fool is the one person unjaded enough to actually take the leap. That's a compliment here, not an insult.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "What if I fail and it all falls apart?"

options.text: That fear's the test — it says yes to the unknown.
Then you'll have proven everyone right.
Failure isn't possible if you don't think about it.

elaboration: Playing it safe was always the other option on the table. The Fool picks the leap anyway.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "But I don't even have a real plan for what's next."

options.text: You don't need it mapped out — the path appears once you step.
Then you're not ready — stay put.
A plan doesn't matter either way.

elaboration: The Fool trusts the ground will be there before it's visible. That's not recklessness — it's the whole point of the card.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Everyone at work thinks I'm insane for even considering this."

options.text: That reaction's the point — it's nonconformist energy.
They're right, you should listen to them.
What others think shouldn't factor in.

elaboration: The Fool was never going to look sensible to everyone else — it's the one card that's fine going against convention.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "I feel like an idiot, starting over at my age."

options.text: That's not foolish — it's a beginner's mind.
Honestly, you waited too long.
Age doesn't come into a reading.

elaboration: A beginner's mind is curious, not behind — unguarded and unjaded is exactly the energy this card wants from you.

beats.speaker: reader
beats.text: One more thing — the Fool travels light. Taking the leap with a little levity beats carrying every worst case with you.
